Exploiting of any sorts is NOT allowed in this game, and you will be punished for it.

How to play:
The board is divided into tiles, with mines randomly distributed.
To win, you need to step on all the safe tiles, without stepping on a mine.
The number on a tile shows the number of mines around it in a 3x3 area.
Using this information, you can determine tiles that are safe, and tiles that contain mines.
Tiles suspected of being mines can be marked with a flag using the left mouse button.

Take turns asking questions. "Is it a man?" "Do they have brown hair?" You only press buttons. No typing.
Your opponent answers Yes or No. Then you look at THEIR board and flip down every face that cannot be it.
When one face is left on their board, guess it. The match does not end there. Your opponent gets time to make their guess too. Then both guesses are shown at the same time. You can BOTH be right.

👑 You get crowns when you win. Use crowns to buy win emotes - a dance your character does on the win screen, so the other player sees it.
🤖 Nobody to play with? Press Play Alone. A bot sits in the other seat and plays a real match.
⭐ How to play

1. Sit on a chair in the lobby
2. Pick your secret face
3. Ask, answer, flip
4. Guess their face before they guess yours

Games.Description:
⚠️ ALPHA — early build, improving every week. DATA RESET IS POSSIBLE

FRONTLINE COMMANDER ⚔️ — the real-time strategy (RTS) war game Roblox never had.
Command an entire ARMY, not one soldier. Outsmart rival commanders in massive PvP battles where real strategy and positioning beat spam.

🏗️ BASE BUILDING & WAR ECONOMY — Build your base, secure supply lines, and tech up toward heavier firepower and higher-tier units.
🏆 CONQUEST — Capture and hold zones in 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 team battles. Earn XP, climb the ranks, and top the global leaderboard.
🎮 Controller supported.
